record.

2. Heard Shri Alok Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the accused/applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Uma Devi for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 0158 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Baghauli,
District Hardoi, during trial.
4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that it is a case of false implication.
The applicant is a lady detained in prison in this case since 10.04.2023.
Charge sheet in this case has already been submitted.

6.

It is vehemently submitted that the applicant is a rustic village lady and is not conversant with the operation of the bank account and the co-accused persons have taken advantage of the same,
however, she did not receive any money in pursuance of any impersonation done by her on the advice of the other accused persons and satisfied by the role of the applicant.

Coordinate Bench of this Court with regard to the sale of same property which was allegedly mortgaged in the Bank had granted bail to the applicant, vide order dated 4.9.2023 passed in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.

It is further submitted that so far as the instant case is concerned, co-accused persons, namely,
Chetram and Ved Prakash who were the guarantors in the Bank have been released on bail by the Coordinate Benches of this Court, vide order dated 7.11.2023 and 28.11.2023 passed in Crl. Misc.
Bail Applications No. 13199 of 2023 and 13995 of 2023 and other co-accused persons of this crime,
namely, Ravi Pratap Singh, Deepak Dwivedi @ Pulli, Bhupendra Kumar Dwivedi and Pravesh Singh,
who have allegedly helped in procuring and manufacturing fake I.Ds have been released on bail by the Coordinate Benches of this Court, vide orders dated 3.10.2023, 3.10.2023, 3.10.2023 and 25.9.2023 passed in Crl.Misc. Bail Applications Nos. 11635 of 2023, 11656 of 2023, 11753 of 2023 and 11530 of 2023, respectively.

sentences.text: 8. It is also submitted that apart from the one other case with regard to the sale of the property the provisions of Gangsters Act have also been invoked against the applicant, however, bail application in that case could only be moved after getting bail in the instant case.
Charge sheet in this case has already been submitted.

She undertakes that she will cooperate in the investigation and there is no apprehension that the accused-applicant after release on bail, may flee from the process of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
Charge sheet in this case has already been submitted.
9. Learned A.G.A. on the other hand submits that the applicant is accused of committing an heinous offence, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.

10. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it would be evident that almost all the accused persons including guarantors and those who have been alleged to have manufactured fake I.Ds. and documents have been granted bail.

Since the two guarantors are alive,
the money of the bank may be secured by initiating any proceedings of recovery against them.

The applicant who is a rustic village lady appears to have been granted bail in another case of the identical nature wherein allegations against her were pertaining to the sale of the same property which was mortgaged in the bank.
The applicant is in jail in this case since 10.04.2023.
Criminal history has been adequately explained.
Charge sheet in this case has already been submitted.
Her presence may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits and demerits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant- Uma Devi involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
13. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
14. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
15. Observations made herein-above are only for the purpose of disposal of bail application and the same shall not have any bearing on the trial of the case.
